content.definition: Low expression comes from timidity, anxiety, or avoidance, without the stable composed baseline and quiet follow-through that distinguish kuudere.
content.en: shy or anxious withdrawal whose reserve is caused by social inhibition
content.ja: 制御された平静さではなく、恥ずかしさや不安から関係を避けるダンデレ的な引きこもり
content.ko: 통제된 침착함이 아니라 수줍음이나 불안 때문에 관계에서 물러나는 단데레식 회피
paraphrases: 부끄러워 말을 못 하고 상대에게서 물러난다
timid avoidance with no calm practical follow-through
恥ずかしくて相手を避けるだけで静かな支援行動はない
